thesis: Pre-open pack for 2026-06-05 remains generic aggregator noise (retail/AI commentary, SoftBank AI-bubble musings, single-name insider-sale and earnings items, routine politician PTR filings) with no dated, broad-market catalyst actionable for a conservative core-ETF sleeve. Existing VTI position (~22.3 of ~107.3 equity, ~21%) and cash buffer (~85, ~79% of equity, well above the 25% floor) remain within all tier limits (1 of max 4 positions, no name near the 25% cap). Holding rather than forcing a trade on thin evidence, consistent with capital preservation.
